extraction.name: Natural Questions
extraction.description: A benchmark for question answering research
extraction.creator: Tom Kwiatkowski, Jennimaria Palomaki, Olivia Redfield, Michael Collins, Ankur Parikh, Chris Alberti, Danielle Epstein, Illia Polosukhin, Jacob Devlin, Kenton Lee, Kristina Toutanova, Llion Jones, Matthew Kelcey, Ming-Wei Chang, Andrew M. Dai, Jakob Uszkoreit, Quoc Le, Slav Petrov
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The questions in NQ are queries of 8 words or more that have been issued to the Google search engine by multiple users in a short period of time. Simple heuristics are used to filter questions from the query stream.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: The data collection process may result in missing data if no Wikipedia page is found in the top 5 search results for a given query.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The raw data collection consists of real anonymized, aggregated queries issued to the Google search engine.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The preprocessing protocol involves filtering out non-questions and retaining queries of 8 words or more in length that are questions.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Annotation is performed using a custom annotation interface, by a pool of around 50 annotators, with an average annotation time of 80 seconds. The guidelines and tooling divide the annotation task into three conceptual stages.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: The annotation quality was constantly monitored. Post hoc evaluation of correctness of non-null answers leads directly to a measure of annotation precision.
extraction.rai:annotationsPerItem: The public release consists of 307,373 training examples with single annotations; 7,830 examples with 5-way annotations for development data; and a further 7,842 examples with 5-way annotated sequestered as test data.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset has significant utility to users and can drive the development of methods for NLU.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The choice of Wikipedia as a source of factual information may introduce biases.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The limitations of previous work with respect to methods and sources used to obtain questions; methods used to annotate and collect answers; methods used to measure and ensure annotation quality; and metrics used for evaluation.
